request_payload.title: A Phase 2/3 Trial of Pabinafusp Alfa, IDS Fused with Anti-Human Transferrin Receptor Antibody, Targeting Neurodegeneration in MPS-II.

mentions.sentence: In order to establish its efficacy and safety, a multicenter, single-arm, open-label phase 2/3 clinical trial was conducted in 28 Japanese patients with mucopolysaccharidosis II (MPS-II, Hunter syndrome) by intravenous administrations of 2.0 mg/kg of pabinafusp alfa for 52 weeks.

candidates.summary: Iduronate-2-sulfatase fused to an antibody that ferries it across the blood-brain barrier via the transferrin receptor, aimed at the neurological form of MPS II

candidates.label: Enzyme replacement for Fabry disease (agalsidase beta, pegunigalsidase alfa)
candidates.summary: Intravenous replacement of alpha-galactosidase A for people with Fabry disease.

candidates.label: Enzyme replacement for Pompe disease (alglucosidase alfa, avalglucosidase alfa, cipaglucosidase alfa)
candidates.summary: Intravenous replacement of acid alpha-glucosidase, the only disease-specific treatment class for Pompe disease.

candidates.label: Olipudase alfa (enzyme replacement for ASMD)
candidates.summary: Intravenous recombinant acid sphingomyelinase, approved only for the non-brain manifestations of ASMD.

candidates.label: IDS-related disorders (mucopolysaccharidosis type II, Hunter syndrome)
candidates.summary: X-linked deficiency of iduronate-2-sulfatase makes heparan and dermatan sulfate build up; the neuronopathic form also causes progressive cognitive decline.

candidates.label: IDUA-related disorders (mucopolysaccharidosis type I: Hurler, Hurler-Scheie, Scheie)
candidates.summary: Deficiency of alpha-L-iduronidase makes dermatan and heparan sulfate build up in many organs: coarse facial features, skeletal disease, heart and airway problem

candidates.label: GAA-related disorders (Pompe disease)
synonyms: GSD due to acid maltase deficiency, infantile onset

candidates.label: GBA1-related disorders (Gaucher disease)

candidates.label: HEXA-related disorders (Tay-Sachs disease)
candidates.summary: Deficiency of hexosaminidase A makes GM2 ganglioside build up in nerve cells: infants lose skills and develop seizures and blindness; later-onset forms progress

candidates.label: ARSA-related disorders (metachromatic leukodystrophy)
candidates.summary: Deficiency of arylsulfatase A makes sulfatides build up and destroys myelin in the brain and nerves, causing loss of motor and cognitive skills.

candidates.label: GALC-related disorders (Krabbe disease)
candidates.summary: Deficiency of galactocerebrosidase leads to toxic psychosine build-up that kills myelin-forming cells; the infantile form is rapidly fatal.

candidates.label: LZTR1-related disorders
synonyms: Noonan syndrome caused by mutation in LZTR1
candidates.summary: LZTR1 changes cause dominant or recessive Noonan syndrome, and loss of one LZTR1 copy predisposes to schwannomatosis or isolated cafe-au-lait spots.

candidates.label: NF1-related disorders (neurofibromatosis type 1)
